questions: How many point contacts did you make on (0 0 1) surfaces, at ambient pressure and in the pressure cell, and how many showed a ZBCP? Your Methods give three samples at ambient pressure and one contact, on S1, under pressure; were there others?
Why were any other contacts or pressure runs set aside?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: point-contact spectra above 1.4 GPa (the cell reaches about 1.8 GPa and Fig. 2b goes to 1.8 GPa), bias beyond ±4 mV, and magnetic field under pressure?
What does the second-best contact look like under pressure, and did the 0.6 to 1.2 GPa spectra repeat on a second contact or on releasing pressure?
What were the normal-state resistances of the S1, S2 and S3 contacts at each pressure, how did you choose the normalization G0, and could you show the raw dI/dV before normalization?

From those resistances and the mean free path implied by RRR ≈ 410, is each contact in the ballistic regime? If you integrate dI/dV to I(V), do the side dips at 0.6 to 1.4 GPa sit at a fixed current as temperature changes?
Did you take field sweeps under pressure, especially between 0.6 and 1.4 GPa near MO1 and MO2? Does the ZBCP split, and do the side dips move with field?

Table S1 lists ∆z = 1.18(7) meV and ∆x(y) = 0.72(4) meV for S1, while Fig. S7a gives ∆x(y) = 1.18(7) meV and ∆z = 0.72(4) meV for the same 0.3 K fit; which labels are right, and how much does ⟨∆z⟩/⟨∆x(y)⟩ move when you refit the 0.6 and 0.8 GPa data with two channels or with the other representations?
